sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: online with a university library login (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Nothing: 0 hits for 'stress' or 'accent' in the whole article. Pero is treated as tonal: a 'tone change linked with the vowel assimilation' where 'the tone of the perfective suffix na has been shifted onto the verb root' (p. 63), and Rule 26 VOWEL DELETION II deletes a morpheme-final low-toned vowel 'along with its tone' (p. 69). No tone inventory or stress statement; the article covers vowels only and refers consonants to Frajzyngier 1978.
